title: Medical Records Requests Desk Guidance on Open Duplicate Requests and Free Copies
content:
## 1. Open duplicate requests

**Rule.** Under Medical Records Requests, a patient has no other open request of the same request type for the same recipient and record scope. An open request is one in status received, authorization pending, in process or extended. A second identical request is not opened, and the requester is given the status of the first.

The test is made against the company's request records before the new request is opened, comparing four things: the patient, the request type, the recipient as named on the request, and the record scope.

| Earlier request of the same patient | Same type, recipient and scope? | Earlier request's status | Effect of this rule on the new request |
|---|---|---|---|
| Exists | Yes | Received, authorization pending, in process or extended | Not opened; the requester is given the earlier request's status |
| Exists | Yes | Fulfilled, denied or cancelled | Not barred as a duplicate; the earlier request is not open |
| Exists | No — differs in type, recipient or scope | Any | Not barred as a duplicate; it is not identical |

## 2. Free copies within a request type

**Rule.** Across a patient's requests of one request type, the first requests fulfilled in a rolling 12 months, up to that type's number of free requests per patient in a rolling 12 months, are free: their fee is waived with the reason "free copy". Later requests are charged. Portal Self-Service Downloads and Provider-to-Provider Transfers carry no fee at all.

**How the free copies already used are counted.** For the request in hand, the count is the number of the patient's other requests of the same type that are fulfilled, whose received date falls within the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the received date of the request in hand, and that carry a fee waiver with the reason "free copy". The request in hand is free while that count is below the type's number of free requests.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases under a request type offering one free request)

| Hypothetical earlier request of the same patient | Counted? | Request in hand |
|---|---|---|
| Same type, fulfilled, received about five months before the request in hand, fee waived as a free copy | Yes | Count is 1, not below 1: charged |
| Same type, fulfilled, received about fourteen months before, fee waived as a free copy | No — received outside the window | Count is 0: free, fee waived as a free copy |
| Same type, fulfilled, received about five months before, fee charged and not waived as a free copy | No — carries no free-copy waiver | Count is 0: free |
| Different type, fulfilled, received about five months before, fee waived as a free copy | No — different type | Count is 0: free |
| Same type, received about five months before, still in process | No — not fulfilled | Count is 0: free |

## Basis questions

**Does a request for the same recipient and scope but under a different request type count as a duplicate?** No. The duplicate test requires the same type, the same recipient and the same record scope.

**Is a free copy shared across request types?** No. Free copies are counted across a patient's requests of one request type only.
